reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: updateMemberAdmin is called from MemberManagementClient.tsx:253 and updateMyProfile from UserProfileForm.tsx:78 — code is live. Gate 2: No trust_assumptions defined; attack vector is authenticated web user submitting untrusted input. Gate 3: src/lib/actions/members.ts is explicitly in scope and input validation (Zod schemas) is a listed key security concern. An attacker can trigger this via the updateMyProfile server action by submitting student_number="" (empty string), which profileUpdateSchema's /^[0-9]*/ regex accepts, causing supabaseAdmin to persist an empty student_number to the DB, violating the numeric-only invariant. An admin can go further via updateMemberAdmin (profileAdminUpdateSchema has no regex) and set student_number to any arbitrary non-numeric string. Severity kept at Low: data integrity violation with no auth bypass, privilege escalation, or data disclosure.
